metabobAnnotation.reason: Fixed critical bug where RecordID objects were not converted to JSON-serializable strings, causing 500 errors on all GET endpoints. The official surrealdb-py library returns RecordID objects in query results which are not JSON serializable by default.
metabobAnnotation.designDecision: Recursive conversion through all data structures (dicts, lists) before returning to FastAPI JSON encoder
